plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) parse annotations.json — count annotations, categories, annotations per image distribution, (3) image dimensions, (4) category frequency distribution (how many categories have <5 annotations), (5) examine metadata.json structure, (6) check data/products/ directory structure and count reference images per product.
plan.success_criteria: Clear log of dataset statistics: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, category distribution, reference image counts

plan.title: Explore dataset and environment without numpy
plan.hypothesis: We can understand the dataset structure using only stdlib (json, pathlib, statistics) and check what packages are available
plan.description: Rewrite scratch.py to use only Python stdlib (no numpy, no PIL). Use json to parse annotations.json and metadata.json. Use pathlib to count images and product directories. Use statistics module for mean/median. Also run 'pip list' via subprocess to see installed packages, check torch availability, check if ultralytics is installed. Print all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Successfully prints dataset statistics (image count, annotation count, category count, annotations per image distribution, category frequency distribution) and environment info (installed packages, CUDA availability)

plan.title: Setup pipeline + YOLOv8n baseline at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A quick YOLOv8n baseline with 356 classes at 640px establishes metrics flow and a baseline val_score > 0.05
plan.description: In main.py: (1) pip install ultralytics if needed, (2) parse annotations.json, (3) create 90/10 stratified train/val split (seed=42), (4) convert to YOLO format (images/train, images/val, labels/train, labels/val), (5) create dataset.yaml with nc=356, (6) train YOLOv8n imgsz=640 epochs=50 batch=16, (7) evaluate on val split computing detection_mAP@0.5 and classification accuracy, (8) compute val_score = 0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP. Print all metrics.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score metric is printed, val_score > 0.01

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=356 at 640px with longer training
plan.hypothesis: Medium model with more epochs improves val_score significantly over nano baseline
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=356, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Evaluate val_score. Compare against nano baseline.

plan.title: Diagnose torch/torchvision environment and fix NMS operator
plan.hypothesis: The NMS operator error is caused by version mismatch between pre-installed torch and torchvision. By diagnosing the exact pre-installed versions and either using them as-is or reinstalling compatible versions, we can get YOLO training working.
plan.description: In scratch.py: (1) Check exact torch and torchvision versions already installed, (2) Test if torchvision.ops.nms works, (3) If not, try uninstalling both and reinstalling matching versions, (4) Test NMS again, (5) Try importing ultralytics and running a minimal YOLO inference test. Report all findings. Do NOT attempt full training yet.
plan.success_criteria: torchvision.ops.nms works without error, ultralytics YOLO can be imported and initialized

plan.title: Force-reinstall torchvision with --no-deps and verify NMS
plan.hypothesis: Using pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps for torchvision will overwrite the broken installation without needing to uninstall first, fixing the NMS operator
plan.description: In main.py, before any training: (1) Run `pip install torchvision==0.21.0 --force-reinstall --no-deps` to force overwrite the broken torchvision. (2) If that fails, try `pip install torchvision --force-reinstall --no-deps` without version pinning. (3) Test torchvision.ops.nms directly. (4) If NMS works, proceed with YOLOv8n 5-epoch smoke test. (5) If NMS still fails, try importing torch and checking if torchvision C extensions are loadable, and report exact error for next step.
plan.success_criteria: torchvision.ops.nms works and YOLOv8n completes at least 1 epoch of training, val_score > 0

plan.title: Fix weights_only=True and run YOLOv8n 5-epoch smoke test
plan.hypothesis: Monkey-patching torch.load to set weights_only=False (or using a compatible ultralytics version) will allow YOLOv8 pretrained weights to load, enabling training to complete with val_score > 0.0
plan.description: Keep the torchvision force-reinstall fix from exp-6. Before importing ultralytics, monkey-patch torch.load: save original torch.load, replace with wrapper that forces weights_only=False. Also try pinning ultralytics to a newer version (8.3.x) that handles torch 2.6 compatibility. Train YOLOv8n for 5 epochs as smoke test. If monkey-patching doesn't work, try setting TORCH_FORCE_WEIGHTS_ONLY=0 env var, or downloading weights manually and loading with safe settings.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes without errors and val_score > 0.0

plan.title: YOLOv8m training at 640px for 30+ epochs
plan.hypothesis: With environment working, YOLOv8m with proper training achieves val_score > 0.05
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=356, imgsz=640, epochs=50, batch=16, patience=20. Keep the torch.load monkey-patch. Use proper evaluation.

plan.title: Extended training with YOLOv8m/l at 640-1280px
plan.hypothesis: Longer training and/or higher resolution improves val_score significantly
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m or YOLOv8l with epochs=100, imgsz=640 or 1280, batch adjusted for memory. Add augmentation tuning.

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and submission
plan.hypothesis: Tuned thresholds and proper evaluation pipeline yield best val_score
plan.description: Assemble final pipeline with best model. Tune confidence thresholds, NMS IoU. Build proper run.py for submission.
